headline: Frequent Rework of Table Functionality
diagnosis: The file 'rich/table.py' is undergoing repeated changes primarily related to column highlighting and padding adjustments. The commit messages indicate a focus on fixing rendering issues and enhancing functionality, suggesting that the current implementation may be unstable or not fully meeting requirements.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the Column class and its associated methods to identify the root causes of the rendering and highlighting issues.
Establish clear requirements for table rendering and column behavior, ensuring that all edge cases are documented and tested.
Implement a comprehensive suite of unit tests specifically targeting the highlighting and padding functionalities to catch regressions early.
Assign a dedicated owner to the table rendering logic to ensure accountability and reduce the bus factor.
owner_hint: A single engineer should be responsible for the table rendering logic.
